advisories.observation: Head-to-body transition is continuous and softer than v001, but broad rounded chin and tiny projecting lip still make the head bulbous in hero/front. The black two-branch mouth reads like a drawn V rather than a fleshy opening. Smaller eyes and quieter mouth help, but natural refinement is partial.

Paired fins end in blunt polygonal paddles; dorsal/tail membranes are stiff fans with some local puckering and line-like rays that can look embossed. These are visible residual low-poly simplifications, not missing fins.

Silver-blue pigment and dorsal gradient are substantially calmer than v001 orange fins and sharply separated dark back. The repeating faint scale/checker rhythm remains somewhat uniform and loses most distinct structure by 80px; there is no observed missing texture or severe seam.

The whole fish has a straight, highly symmetrical lateral body. It is credible as a static stylized prop but the requested gently arced pose/natural liveliness is weak; no animation readiness claimed.

comparison: V002 reduces oversized bright eye/orange plate fins, removes hard two-tone back/flank split and gives body a continuous rounded head and tapered caudal mass.
